BrochureContent.Content:
HWP Estate Agents are delighted to present No. Apartment 114, Kilmainham Square, Inchicore Road, Inchicore, Dublin 8 to the residential property market.

No. 114 is a superb three-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment presented in excellent condition throughout. Ideally located within this well-maintained and highly sought-after development, the property offers spacious and well-balanced accommodation, perfect for both owner-occupiers and investors alike.

The apartment comprises a welcoming L-shaped entrance hallway, a bright and generously proportioned living/dining area, and a modern fully fitted kitchen. There are three well-sized bedrooms, including a master bedroom with en-suite, along with a stylish main bathroom. Large windows throughout ensure an abundance of natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

Kilmainham Square enjoys a prime location directly opposite the historic Kilmainham Gaol and the entrance to the Royal Hospital Kilmainham & IMMA. The area is well-served by an excellent selection of cafés, shops, restaurants, and bars, including Dublin Food Co-op, Loaf Café & Bakery, Cool Hands Coffee, La Dolce Vita, Riggers D8, The Patriot?s Inn, and The Royal Oak.
For outdoor enthusiasts, the Memorial Gardens, Phoenix Park, and the Grand Canal are all within a short walk, offering superb recreational amenities. Transport links are excellent, with the Red Line LUAS at Suir Road and Heuston Station nearby, providing quick and easy access to the city centre. There are also numerous Dublin Bus routes and a Dublin Bikes station in the vicinity.
The adjacent Hilton Hotel offers access to a leisure centre, swimming pool, and spa facilities, while the new Children?s Hospital at St. James?s is conveniently located within walking distance.

This property represents an ideal opportunity to acquire a spacious home in a vibrant and convenient Dublin location.

Viewing Early is Highly advised
